content.value: What do you mean by decision tree? Let us assume the following discount policy:

Bookstores get a trade discount of 30% for orders from libraries and individuals; 5% allowed on orders of 6-19 copies per book title; 10% on orders for 20-40 copies per book title; 20% on orders for 41 copies or more per book title. For all the cases no-discount for less than 6 copies of book title.
Now using this discount policy draw a decision tree.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
